Ai._comment_AnalysisRepair: Production policy for the analysis-output repair layer (Ai:AnalysisRepair, see AnalysisRepairOptions in Services/Ai/AiOptions.cs). This block MIRRORS base appsettings.json (Enabled:true, GuardOnly:true, glossary-on for all PerType) because prod currently serves Ollama-LOCAL models via Ai:FeatureModels (gemma4:12b / qwen3.5:9b / DictaLM-3.0) - a leaky tier where the deterministic glossary guard still earns its keep. KEEP IN SYNC with Ai:FeatureModels: the model actually served in prod. Do NOT make this a no-op on the assumption a cloud tier is leak-free: a 2026-07-10 3-passage cloud sweep (google/gemma-4-31b-it via OpenRouter) leaked English into Hebrew prose at the SAME ~1/3 rate as local gemma4:12b (local leaked 'confusion', cloud leaked 'claustrophobia'; both out-of-glossary abstract nouns). No measured tier is leak-free on this task, so keep the guard ON across tiers (it is a zero-cost no-op on clean fields). CAVEAT: the deterministic glossary only cleans its ~35 curated craft terms, NOT the general-vocabulary leaks seen in the wild - a dynamic detect-and-repair replacement for the closed glossary is under design (see docs/ANALYSIS_OUTPUT_REPAIR.md). Extension point (documented only, NOT implemented): a per-provider/per-model override on AnalysisRepairOptions is only needed if a single environment ever serves MULTIPLE tiers at once (e.g. some requests to a cloud model, others to local Ollama, in the same deployment) - see the AnalysisRepairOptions xmldoc in Services/Ai/AiOptions.cs for the full note.
